page.overview:
Who is Lilith?

Great Ones (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands) Old Ones (formerly)

Lilith is a demonic entity from Jewish mythology, incorporated into the Cthulhu Mythos by H. P. Lovecraft's short story "The Horror at Red Hook". Since then, she has been reused by other authors in stories and role-playing game material.

Traditionally, Lilith is described as an ageless woman of sinister beauty, known for visiting sleeping men, with whom she then engages in somnambular sex. However, Lovecraft changes her appearance, depicting her as an entity with "leprous limbs" and phosphorescent skin (: "The Horror at Red Hook").

According to one account, she is an avatar of Our Ladies of Sorrow (: Our Ladies of Sorrow), but according to others, she is either a Great One (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands) or an Ancient One that can also assume the form of a female gug in our material plane (: Cthulhu Dark Ages). In the Malleus Monstrorum, it is said that she was originally an Ancient One (2006 edition) or Old One (2020 edition), but was banished to Earth's Dreamlands at some unknown time and became a Great One. It is said that she will someday regain enough strength to escape from the Dreamlands (: Malleus Monstrorum).
